policy_extraction.implementation_notes: This Roadmap is a companion to AI RMF 1.0, voluntary and non-sector specific. Key priorities include international standards alignment, expanded TEVV efforts, AI RMF profiles, guidance on trustworthiness tradeoffs, measuring framework effectiveness, case studies, human factors guidance, explainability guidance, risk tolerance methods, and multi-disciplinary tutorials. NIST's involvement depends on available resources.

risk_framing.rationale_summary: The document primarily frames AI governance around managing risks to ensure trustworthy and responsible AI systems, focusing on protecting individuals, groups, and society from harms. Secondary framings include rights-preservation and enabling responsible innovation through voluntary, flexible frameworks.

evidence_spans.quote: the goal of the AI RMF is to offer a voluntary resource to the organizations designing, developing, deploying, or using AI systems to help manage the many risks of AI and promote trustworthy and responsible development and use of AI systems
The Framework is intended to be voluntary, rights-preserving, non-sector specific
NIST intends to investigate how human-AI teams should best be configured to reduce likelihood of negative impacts/harms to individuals, groups, communities, and society
